## English

Mohe (墨核) is a quiet, clever local companion for long-running work, created by [Shixi Lin](https://github.com/shixi-11). This release includes two independent editions of the same character.

### Choose your edition

#### Codex Pet

Download [`Mohe-Codex-Pet-v1.0.1.zip`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/Mohe-Codex-Pet-v1.0.1.zip) if you want Mohe inside Codex. The package includes idle, directional movement, waving, jumping, waiting, working, review, and look-around animations.

#### Windows desktop pet

Download [`Mohe-Windows-Portable-v1.0.1.zip`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/Mohe-Windows-Portable-v1.0.1.zip) if you want a standalone desktop companion with touch reactions, grooming mode, autonomous moods, local memory, focus sessions, and an activity trail.

The two editions are independent. Install either one or keep both.

### Highlights in v1.0.1

- Six recognizable moods and forms, including rolling and furball states.
- Different reactions for the ears, head, chest, paws, tail, and body.
- Double-click grooming mode; right-click returns the brush to the normal pointer.
- Local-first memory with no account, telemetry, or cloud sync.
- Refined transparent artwork, motion timing, typography, and Windows presentation.

### Install and verify

- [Installation, usage, and troubleshooting](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md)
- [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/SHA256SUMS.txt) for download verification

## 简体中文

墨核是一只安静、聪明，会守护长期工作的本地小兽，由[光之十一](https://github.com/shixi-11)创作。本次 Release 同时提供同一角色的两个独立版本。

### 选择版本

#### Codex 宠物版

如果想让墨核住进 Codex，请下载 [`Mohe-Codex-Pet-v1.0.1.zip`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/Mohe-Codex-Pet-v1.0.1.zip)。宠物包包含待机、定向移动、挥手、跳跃、等待、工作、审查和环视等动作。

#### Windows 桌面宠物版

如果想让墨核常驻独立窗口，请下载 [`Mohe-Windows-Portable-v1.0.1.zip`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/Mohe-Windows-Portable-v1.0.1.zip)。桌面版包含部位触摸、梳毛模式、自主心情、本地记忆、专注计时和动态记录。

两个版本互不依赖，可以任选其一，也可以同时保留。

### v1.0.1 亮点

- 六种易于辨认的心情与形态，包括打滚和毛团。
- 耳朵、头顶、胸口、前爪、尾巴和身体有不同回应。
- 双击进入梳毛模式，右键将毛刷恢复为普通鼠标。
- 记忆保存在本机，不需要账号，不含统计与云端同步。
- 优化透明素材、动作节奏、文字排版与 Windows 显示效果。

### 安装与校验

- [安装、使用与故障排查教程](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/blob/main/docs/getting-started.zh-CN.md)
- 使用 [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://github.com/shixi-11/mohe-pet/releases/download/v1.0.1/SHA256SUMS.txt) 核对下载文件是否完整
